senses.gloss: m. (יָסַר) correction by example, warning example.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 45a:7">Snh. 45ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 23:48">Ez. XXIII, 48</cite>) <he>אין לך יי׳ גדול מזה</he> there is no severer warning than this (capital punishment, and therefore disgrace by exposure would be an unnecessary hardship).

senses.gloss: Pl. יִסּוּרִים, יִסּוּרִין, יִי׳ corrections by suffering, suffering, trials, visitation.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 32:9">Sifré Deut. 32</cite> <he>חביבים י׳ לפני … על מי שיי׳ באים עליו</he> trials are precious in the sight of the Lord, for the glory of the Lord rests upon him who is visited with trials (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 8:5">Deut. VIII, 5</cite>).
<cite ref="Deuteronomy 8:5">Ib.</cite> <he>הי׳ מרצים וכ׳</he> sufferings atone more than sacrifices.

<cite ref="Berakhot 5a:10">Ber. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ של אהבה</he> visitations of (divine) love (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 3:12">Prov. III, 12</cite>). Ib.ᵇ <he>חביבין עליך י׳</he> are the sufferings welcome to thee (as trials)?—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:16">Cant. R. to II, 16</cite> <he>מה קשין הן הי׳</he> how hard to bear are sufferings!; a. v. fr.
